scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun fapony.ts test
scripts.git:sync: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main
scripts.git:merge-pr: gh pr create --base main --fill 2>/dev/null; gh pr merge --squash
scripts.git:reset: git fetch origin main -q && git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && git diff --quiet HEAD origin/main && git reset --hard origin/main || echo '❌ มี uncommitted changes หรือ commit ที่ยังไม่ landing เข้า main — push + merge PR ก่อนแล้วค่อย reset'
scripts.git:mr: bun run git:merge-pr && bun run git:reset
